description.value: North Burnaby Neighbourhood House (BNH North House) is a community-driven social services centre offering programs for families, seniors, newcomers, youth, and food-insecure residents in the Hastings corridor of Burnaby. It is one of three locations operated by Burnaby Neighbourhood House, a registered charity with deep roots in the surrounding communities. A touring cyclist passing through the area might stop here for community resources or as a rest point along Hastings Street.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The specific OSM URL (burnabynh.ca/locations-n/) returned a 404, but multiple subpages on the same domain confirm the BNH North House at 4908 Hastings St, Burnaby, BC with phone (604) 294-5444, establishing the place is real and open. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content. The OSM 'community' field lists 'North Vancouver' but the physical address and all website references place this location in Burnaby.
concerns: OSM URL (https://burnabynh.ca/locations-n/) returns a 404; the correct website appears to be https://burnabynh.ca/ — website field updated to the working root URL.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible community centre confirmed by website with current contact details. Useful to touring cyclists as a potential rest or resource stop along Hastings Street.
enrichment_extras.notes: Food security programs, newcomer settlement services, and seniors outreach are the primary offerings. No cyclist-specific amenities confirmed. A staff call or site visit would be needed to verify washrooms, water, or bike parking availability.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tags this as a community_centre; it is a social-services neighbourhood house, not a tourist attraction. Consider recategorizing as Community Services or similar if that category exists in the directory.

wow_evidence: Charitable neighbourhood house with public programs — walk-in (consistent with Fairfield Community Place).
blurb: Neighbourhood house with family and newcomer programs on Hastings.
